name: K-C Warren Advanced Manufacturing Facility - Warren OH
type: New advanced manufacturing facility (Huggies, Pull-Ups, Kleenex, Scott, Viva, Kotex, Poise, Depend; ~1.2M sq ft, $800M, under construction)

fieldNotes.site: Facility under construction. Located on the 560-acre former Republic Steel / BDM Steel brownfield off Pine Avenue (Niles River Road), spanning Howland Twp, Warren Twp and the City of Warren. Mahoning River bounds the property on the west; a NE-SW rail line runs through the site.
fieldNotes.imagery: Current Maxar/Airbus satellite layer and the Nov-2024 Street View pano both PREDATE the K-C building. The cleared/graded brownfield is visible but no plant structure, gates, docks or yard pavement appear yet. Per K-C (Vindicator, Jan 2026) the manufacturing building is 'sealed up and weathertight'; production begins H1 2027. The white-roofed building and aggregate/sand-gravel operation visible in the SE of current imagery are pre-existing/separate, not the K-C plant.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail line crosses the property NE-SW; a steel-mill site this size will almost certainly retain rail service for the new plant. Marked true with medium confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is <1 mile from Warren's Courthouse Square, embedded in the Warren urban fabric (residential grids on both sides). Classified Urban.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: All yard counts are 0 because no yard infrastructure exists in available imagery. buildingCount 0 reflects the imagery, not the planned facility (1 plant building plus a proposed 500k-sq-ft DC across Pine Ave). siteAreaAcres 560 is the documented purchased acreage, not derived from the perimeter box.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Perimeter box drawn around the visibly cleared brownfield footprint; approximate, since the eventual fenced plant pad will occupy only part of the 560-acre parcel.

citations.claim: K-C $800M, ~1M sq ft Warren facility; production begins first half of 2027, full capacity by 2030 (not yet operational).
Warren OH plant ~1.2M sq ft, construction to commence May 2025, completion in two to three years (~2027-2028).

verification.rationale: Under construction; production not until H1 2027 per K-C/state sources - not a current operating facility; rejected per current-ops rule.
